title: Keto Norwegian Almond Flour Biscuits
description: A keto friendly biscuit recipe made with almond flour and Norwegian ingredients.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, combine almond flour, quick oats, sugar-free sweetener, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut into desired shapes using a biscuit cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place the biscuits on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 12-14 minutes or until lightly golden.
Remove from the oven and let cool on a wire rack.
